title: The signed-out Feed shows members' posts with joins as one quiet line, not a column of Vera posts

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14: the anonymous feed looks like trash and is riddled with Vera posts; show micro notices where people joined, Vera should not be posting that. Same day: make the gate a friendly pitch with a join-the-movement mood, and greet them as Friend, not Anonymous.

detail: public_posts returns no post_type, so the system profile's automated lines (lib/system-line.ts, drawn as Vera) reached the anonymous Feed as full posts: 23 of the 30 public posts on 2026-10-14. loadAnonPosts now reads 50, leaves streak milestones off the public Feed, and folds each run of join notices into one post_type 'system' row ('@a, @b and 3 more joined'), which PostItem draws as the member Feed's centred .fa-join notice; that notice is now a compact muted line. The Up next card no longer paints an empty sand photo pane for an event with no art (its badge sits by the kicker), and the anonymous rail's Coming up reads event times in UTC like formatEventDate, so a 9am start no longer shows as 2am. The signed-out stand-in reads as Friend ('Good evening, Friend.'), and the join overlay becomes a warm pitch: eyebrow Frequency Community Collective, 'Join the movement.', a line on local Circles, events and practices across North County, free in beta, with Join the movement, Find out more (/about) and a quiet Log in line.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('lib/feed/anon-feed.ts','utf8');const p=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/feed/planner.tsx','utf8');const r=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/shell/right-rail.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!a.includes('SYSTEM_HANDLE')||!a.includes('function joinLine'))bad.push('Vera lines are not folded');if(!/post_type: 'system'/.test(a))bad.push('joins are not drawn as the system notice');if(!/hero\.coverUrl \?/.test(p))bad.push('a coverless Up next still paints a photo pane');const i=r.indexOf('async function AnonComingUp');if(i<0||r.slice(i,i+2500).includes('HOME_TZ'))bad.push('the anonymous Coming up reads event times in HOME_TZ');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-911: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
